answers.harness: Yes at the input-contract level: baseline explicitly supplies j<=p, including the current logical position, to SDK decode whose ordinary decomposed prior interface requires j<p. This matches the HF full past+current mask convention but does not prove how or why the harness author chose it.
answers.installed_regular_service: The inspected installed ordinary text serving path does not use the same inclusive construction: runner carries full=p+1,computed=p; loader passes attention_mask=None; SDK single-token inference computes j<=p-1. This is source evidence about that path, not observation of a running server or a blanket guarantee for every configuration.
answers.responsibility_location: The explicit input construction is in baseline_neuron_v5 numeric294/cold350/long404 (same inclusive construction in v4). matched32/history/original88 reproduce these frozen inputs; CPUAdapter84 enforces the inherited inclusive convention. The source mismatch is upstream of SDK prior/active computation, not newly introduced by the observer.

contract_comparison.HF: Native driver passes p+1 mask ones because native attention consumes prior plus current as a joined logical domain.
contract_comparison.SDK_prior: compute_for_token_gen explicitly documents true only for index<computed_context_len; masks prior_scores separately, then computes active current K/V and combines the branches.
contract_comparison.explicit_harness: j<=p includes bucket slot p in the prior mask. _create_simple_attn_mask only expands/casts; it does not subtract/remove currentposition.

illustrative_source_semantics_only.note: The extra prior slot24 is cached storage, not proven equal to the freshly computed current K/V; do not describe this as necessarily duplicating identical current values.

contract_comparison.normal_serving: attention_mask=None triggers _infer_attention_mask, which uses position_ids-1 and j<=p-1 for single-token decode. Runner full_context_lens=p+1 is not itself an inclusive attentionmask; computed_context_lens=p remains separately available.
contract_comparison.p: Zero-based current input token position, equal to number of already computed prior tokens on the ordinary one-token decode path.

input_lineage.baseline: baseline_v5._numeric explicitmask -> _load.forward -> official SDK model.forward with explicitattention_mask; inference fallback is bypassed.
input_lineage.history: history_tensors.source/graph_inputs supplies saved control inputs to CPU and device paths; C_Hd/C_Hc change history origin only, retaining maskvalues.
input_lineage.matched32: device_v2 wraps graph _forward, records all7 actual padded inputs, then calls original baseline._numeric; CPUv2 loads exactly those inputs and widens integerdtype losslessly.
input_lineage.original88: CPUAdapter loads pinned graph payload; capture driver retains graph inputs and verifies inclusive position/mask invariant before model forward.
input_lineage.payload_paths_are_metadata_only: No referenced pt/raw/zlib file was statted, read, hashed, decompressed or executed in this review.

scope_limits: No actual mask bytes were decoded here; the separate saved-mask analyzer must establish observed allowed-key values.
No causal link to prior numerical failures, first-five/RoPE discrepancies, cache history differences or final logits is established.
No model/source/input changes, mask repair, arithmetic replay or new baseline is performed.
Installed path identified through editable finder metadata; no running service/modules inspected.

Serving conclusion limited to inspected standard text continuous-batching, single-token, ordinary SDK decode path; prefix/chunked/speculative/multimodal and historical code versions are not certified.
Cold and long baseline use same inclusive source expressions; their actual results and model gates are not reevaluated by this source review.

def _infer_attention_mask(
        self,
        position_ids,
        full_context_lens: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
        computed_context_lens: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
    ):
        assert (
            position_ids is not None
        ), "need to call forward with position_ids if attention_mask is not provided"

        batch_size, seq_len = position_ids.shape
        if position_ids.shape[-1] != 1:
            seq_len = position_ids.shape[-1]
            position_ids_to_compare = position_ids
        else:
            seq_len = torch.max(position_ids)
            position_ids_to_compare = position_ids.expand(batch_size, seq_len) - 1
        mask = torch.arange(seq_len).view(1, -1).expand(batch_size, seq_len)
        attention_mask = (position_ids_to_compare >= mask).to(dtype=position_ids.dtype)
        return attention_mask
